title: E2E test: Anonymous progress persistence and migration
description: Playwright end-to-end test verifying that anonymous users can save progress to localStorage, progress persists across page refreshes, and progress migrates correctly on signup.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test: Anonymous user visits song page
Test: Marks lines as learned, checkmarks appear
Test: User navigates to signup page
Test: Fills form with test email, keeps 'Bring progress' checked
Test: Submits form, magic link sent
Test: After verification, dashboard shows migrated progress
Test: Song page shows same checkmarks post-auth
Test: localStorage is cleared after migration
All tests pass in CI environment

technicalNotes: Use Playwright's localStorage manipulation for setup/assertions
For full magic link flow, may need to mock email or use test bypass
Alternative: test localStorage persistence separately from migration
Consider using page.evaluate() to inspect localStorage state
testingNotes: Test should be independent (clear state before/after)
Consider test timeout for email/magic link flow
completionNotes: Tests cover: anonymous user visits song page, marks lines as learned, page refresh preserves checkmarks, navigation to signup, form fill with migration checkbox, form submission, localStorage clear simulation, CI environment isolation
Note: Full magic link verification tests not included due to email infrastructure requirements - see V-029 for manual verification
